claim: Stochastic Petri nets are an established formalism in MTD evaluation (Cho and Ben-Asher use one).
quote: We develop a Stochastic Petri Nets (SPN) model … in order to evaluate the performance of a cyber security system that utilizes IDS, deception, and/or MTD.
issue: The source is one instance of an SPN used to evaluate a defence that includes MTD (platform migration) alongside IDS and deception; it does not say SPNs are established in MTD evaluation. Supports 'have been used', a weaker claim than 'established'.
fix_text: "are an established formalism in MTD evaluation" -> "have been used to evaluate MTD" (or keep, if the two cites are read jointly as precedent).
